skill.summary: Interactive guide for integrating MobTech MobLink into Android projects with step-by-step workflow. Use when user says "MobLink集成", "Link集成", "Android深度链接",...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of android-moblink-integration skill.

- Provides an interactive, step-by-step workflow for integrating MobTech MobLink into Android projects.
- Guides users through project validation, MobLink configuration registration, SDK integration, privacy compliance, and scene restoration implementation.
- Supports both Groovy and Kotlin Gradle DSLs with configuration templates and user confirmation at each step.
- Includes detailed instructions for privacy policy handling and MobCustomController setup.
- Offers official documentation links and validation rules to ensure accurate integration and compliance.
- Responds to relevant trigger phrases such as MobLink集成, Android深度链接, Gradle配置, 场景还原, and privacy requirements.
